We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the sample's compound. We have no direct description of the compound. We can get NMR spectra to infer methyl groups. Use proton NMR to see signals around 0.9 ppm typical for CH3. Could also use carbon NMR for methyl carbon ~10-30 ppm.

We need to measure proton NMR. Use tool proton_nmr_spectra (requires SMILES? It says for a given SMILES string. But we don't have SMILES. The sample at hand maybe unknown; tool may just measure for sample at hand without SMILES? The description says "returns the 1H NMR spectra for a given SMILES string." But we have no SMILES. Maybe we cannot use it. Could use carbon_nmr_spectra (no args). That measures sample at hand. Use that to see number of methyl carbon signals.

Let's call carbon_nmr_spectra.
